Details and measured discrepancy preserved in results/rejected_newtonian and docs/AUDIT.md. No successful independent-gauge validation is claimed.
saved_CLASS_analysis.constant_conventions: Python uses the explicit SI constants in numerics.json. CLASS uses its pinned constants, thermal quadrature and streaming approximations. Neither was retuned to force agreement.
